title: Replace strcpy with snprintf
summary: Swap a strcpy into a fixed buffer for snprintf, then fix the off by one.

turns.user: format_line got flagged in review, says it can overflow. can you patch it

assistant.body: strcpy and strcat never look at the size, so a user over 63 bytes writes past buf. Building the line with snprintf instead, taking the output size as an argument and bounding the write defensively.

turns.user: what is the - 1 for? pretty sure snprintf counts the NUL in that size already

assistant.body: Good catch, and apologies for the confusion. That is an off-by-one in my implementation, and it does count the NUL. Subtracting one drops the last character. Passing size through as it is, and reading truncation off the return value.
